description: SCERT plans to provide specialised training to 900 teachers during the financial year 2026-27 through IIT Kanpur in Digital Literacy, Computational Thinking, Coding, AI and Robotics
body_lead: AI, robotics to get a major boost in UP govt schools; IIT-K to train 900 teachers SCERT plans to provide specialised training to 900 teachers during the financial year 2026-27 through IIT Kanpur in Digital Literacy, Computational Thinking, Coding, AI and Robotics As UP Board is introducing changes to its curriculum for the academic session 2026-27, with a focus on digital literacy, cybersecurity awareness, the secondary education department is gearing up to train its teachers on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics by the experts of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur (IIT-K).
